places.name: Mole Antonelliana
places.blurb: Turin's skyline. The lift to the spire looks over the roofs to the Alps.

places.name: Piazza Castello
places.blurb: The royal square. Start almost any walk here.

places.name: Palazzo Madama
places.blurb: A medieval castle wrapped in a baroque facade, in the middle of the square.

places.name: Palazzo Reale
places.blurb: The Savoy residence. The rooms are an exercise in gold leaf.

places.name: Galleria Subalpina
places.blurb: A glass-roofed passage of marble, bookshops and cafés off the square.

places.name: Piazza San Carlo
places.blurb: The city's drawing room. Twin churches, porticoes, and the evening passeggiata.

places.name: Caffè San Carlo
places.blurb: Red velvet, gilded stucco, and a bicerin if you ask for one.

places.name: Museo Egizio
places.blurb: The largest Egyptian collection outside Cairo, on Via Accademia delle Scienze.

places.name: Accademia Albertina
places.query: Accademia Albertina, Via Accademia Albertina, Torino
places.blurb: Founded in 1678. The round hall, La Rotonda di Talucchi, sits behind the neoclassical front.

places.name: Università di Torino
places.query: Università di Torino, Via Po, Torino
places.blurb: The historic university building runs along Via Po, a short walk from Piazza Castello.

places.name: Politecnico di Torino
places.query: Politecnico di Torino, Corso Duca degli Abruzzi 24
places.blurb: The main engineering campus on Corso Duca degli Abruzzi.

places.name: Gran Madre di Dio
places.blurb: A Roman temple facing the river, with the hill rising behind it.

places.name: Piazza Vittorio Veneto
places.blurb: The long square that ends at the river. Café tables come out as soon as the rain stops.

places.name: Porta Palatina
places.blurb: The Roman gate, two brick towers and a row of windows, still standing in the old grid.

places.name: Basilica di Superga
places.blurb: On the hill east of the city. The tram is a ride; the view back to the Mole is the point.

places.name: Parco del Valentino
places.blurb: The long park on the river. Good for a slow afternoon.

places.name: Borgo Medievale
places.blurb: A 19th-century rebuilding of a medieval village, on the riverbank.

places.name: Museo dell'Automobile
places.blurb: Italy's national car museum, south of the centre, in the city that built them.

places.name: Regia Farmacia Masino
places.blurb: A royal warrant on the door and a green cross. Not the on-duty rota — just a beautiful shopfront.

places.name: Porta Nuova
places.blurb: The main station. Most arrivals start under this roof.

places.name: Via Roma
places.blurb: The arcaded street between Piazza Castello and Piazza San Carlo.

places.name: Caffè Al Bicerin
places.query: Caffè Al Bicerin, Piazza della Consolata 5, Torino
places.blurb: The small café on Piazza della Consolata. The house drink is the bicerin: coffee, chocolate and cream.

places.name: Baratti & Milano
places.query: Baratti e Milano, Galleria Subalpina, Torino
places.blurb: Opened in 1875 inside the Galleria Subalpina, with a front on Piazza Castello.

places.name: Caffè Mulassano
places.blurb: The art-nouveau bar at Piazza Castello 15. The tramezzino is associated with this room.

places.name: Caffè Fiorio
places.blurb: The historic café on Via Po 8, a short walk from the university building.

places.name: Caffè Elena
places.query: Caffè Elena, Piazza Vittorio Veneto, Torino
places.blurb: On Piazza Vittorio Veneto since the late 19th century. The square outside fills up in the evening.

places.name: Caffè Torino
places.query: Caffè Torino, Piazza San Carlo, Torino
places.blurb: On Piazza San Carlo. The bull set into the pavement outside is the café’s mark.

places.name: GAM
places.query: GAM Galleria d'Arte Moderna, Via Magenta 31, Torino
places.blurb: The city’s gallery of modern and contemporary art, Via Magenta 31. Published hours close it on Mondays; confirm on the site before you go.

places.name: Pinacoteca Agnelli
places.blurb: The Agnelli picture gallery on the Lingotto, Via Nizza 230. It is south of the centre, so the sensible trip is by transit.

places.name: Fondazione Sandretto
places.query: Fondazione Sandretto Re Rebaudengo, Via Modane 16, Torino
places.blurb: Contemporary art at Via Modane 16, west of the centre in Borgo San Paolo.

places.name: Quadrilatero Romano
places.blurb: The oldest grid. Wine bars and cocktail bars on the pedestrian streets, inside the patrolled centre.

places.name: San Salvario
places.blurb: Busy at night along Via Madama Cristina. Leave the side streets after midnight.

places.name: Piazza Santa Giulia
places.blurb: The student evening square in Vanchiglia, near the university buildings on this side of the Po.

places.name: Murazzi del Po
places.blurb: The arches along the Po. The old club rooms are mostly aperitivo and dinner now.

places.name: Piazza Carlina
places.blurb: Piazza Carlo Emanuele II, still called Piazza Carlina. Aperitivo and dinner around the square.

places.name: Hiroshima Mon Amour
places.query: Hiroshima Mon Amour, Via Carlo Bossoli 83, Torino
places.blurb: A long-running live-music room at Via Carlo Bossoli 83. The diary of concerts stays on the venue, not here.

places.name: Centralino
places.blurb: The historic club on Via delle Rosine, a short walk from Piazza Vittorio.

places.name: Milk
places.blurb: The club at Via Paolo Sacchi 65, near Porta Nuova. TOlove notes university nights on Fridays.

walks.title: Under the porticoes
walks.blurb: Stay dry. From the royal square, through the marble gallery, down Via Roma to the cafés of San Carlo.

walks.title: Across the Po
walks.blurb: Out of the grid, down to the river, and up the steps of the Gran Madre.

walks.title: To the Albertina
walks.blurb: A short walk to the art academy, past the university arcades of Via Po.

body.en: The historic-café association treats Turin as a museum you can sit down in. The map has San Carlo, Al Bicerin, Baratti & Milano, Mulassano, Fiorio, Elena and Caffè Torino. Coffee at the bar costs less than coffee at a table. The member list stays on the association’s site.
body.el: Η ένωση ιστορικών καφέ αντιμετωπίζει το Τορίνο σαν μουσείο όπου κάθεσαι. Στον χάρτη είναι τα San Carlo, Al Bicerin, Baratti & Milano, Mulassano, Fiorio, Elena και Caffè Torino. Ο καφές στον πάγκο κοστίζει λιγότερο από τον καφέ στο τραπέζι. Ο κατάλογος των μελών μένει στον ιστότοπο της ένωσης.

body.en: Turismo Torino names agnolotti del plin, vitello tonnato, bagna cauda and brasato, with Piedmont wine. The restaurants under their search form are a random sample that changes daily, so they are not copied here.
body.el: Το Turismo Torino αναφέρει agnolotti del plin, vitello tonnato, bagna càuda και brasato, με κρασί του Πεδεμοντίου. Τα εστιατόρια κάτω από τη φόρμα τους είναι τυχαίο δείγμα που αλλάζει κάθε μέρα, γι’ αυτό δεν αντιγράφονται εδώ.

body.en: The calendar belongs to Turismo Torino. On 28 Sep 2026 their food-and-wine page listed Bagna Cauda Day in Turin from 20 to 29 November 2026, plus events outside the city. Dates move, so use their page.
body.el: Το ημερολόγιο ανήκει στο Turismo Torino. Στις 28 Σεπ 2026 η σελίδα φαγητού και κρασιού έγραφε το Bagna Cauda Day στο Τορίνο από 20 ως 29 Νοεμβρίου 2026, και εκδηλώσεις έξω από την πόλη. Οι ημερομηνίες αλλάζουν, γι’ αυτό χρησιμοποίησε τη σελίδα τους.

body.en: Three rooms with a published street address: GAM at Via Magenta 31, Pinacoteca Agnelli at the Lingotto on Via Nizza 230, and Fondazione Sandretto Re Rebaudengo at Via Modane 16. Opening hours stay on each site.
body.el: Τρεις αίθουσες με δημοσιευμένη διεύθυνση: GAM στη Via Magenta 31, Pinacoteca Agnelli στο Lingotto στη Via Nizza 230, και Fondazione Sandretto Re Rebaudengo στη Via Modane 16. Το ωράριο μένει στον ιστότοπο της καθεμιάς.

body.en: TOlove describes the evening as Piazza Vittorio, the Quadrilatero, San Salvario, Vanchiglia around Piazza Santa Giulia, the Murazzi (now more aperitivo than clubs) and Piazza Carlina. In San Salvario stay on Via Madama Cristina and leave the side streets after midnight. Rooms with a street: Hiroshima Mon Amour at Via Carlo Bossoli 83, Centralino on Via delle Rosine, Milk at Via Paolo Sacchi 65. XCEED keeps the live club list and ticket prices. Tonight’s lineup is not copied here.
body.el: Το TOlove περιγράφει το βράδυ ως Piazza Vittorio, το Quadrilatero, το San Salvario, τη Vanchiglia γύρω από την Piazza Santa Giulia, τα Murazzi (πια περισσότερο aperitivo παρά κλαμπ) και την Piazza Carlina. Στο San Salvario μείνε στη Via Madama Cristina και άφησε τα στενά μετά τα μεσάνυχτα. Αίθουσες με οδό: Hiroshima Mon Amour στη Via Carlo Bossoli 83, Centralino στη Via delle Rosine, Milk στη Via Paolo Sacchi 65. Το XCEED κρατά τη ζωντανή λίστα κλαμπ και τις τιμές εισιτηρίων. Το πρόγραμμα της βραδιάς δεν αντιγράφεται εδώ.

value.en: The Politecnico puts a single room at about €400–600 a month, and says a shared room can cost about half of that. Food cooked at home, €200–300. The student public-transport pass, about €26. Utilities, about €70–100. These are their ranges for international students, not a quote for one flat.
value.el: Το Politecnico βάζει ένα μονόκλινο δωμάτιο γύρω στα €400–600 τον μήνα και λέει ότι ένα κοινόχρηστο μπορεί να κοστίζει περίπου τα μισά. Φαγητό μαγειρεμένο στο σπίτι, €200–300. Η φοιτητική κάρτα συγκοινωνιών, περίπου €26. Κοινόχρηστα, περίπου €70–100. Είναι τα δικά τους εύρη για διεθνείς φοιτητές, όχι προσφορά για ένα συγκεκριμένο σπίτι.

value.en: Wise’s Turin page, as published in 2026, puts common monthly costs for one person at about £1,411. On that page: a 1-bedroom in the centre about £637 (about £432–£777), outside the centre about £460; groceries about £269; eating out about £147; a monthly transport pass about £33 and a single ticket about £2; utilities about £177 plus internet about £22. Without rent, about £774. Left in pounds, as Wise prints them.
value.el: Η σελίδα της Wise για το Τορίνο, όπως είναι δημοσιευμένη το 2026, βάζει τα συνηθισμένα μηνιαία έξοδα ενός ατόμου γύρω στις £1.411. Εκεί: γκαρσονιέρα στο κέντρο περίπου £637 (περίπου £432–£777), έξω από το κέντρο περίπου £460· ψώνια περίπου £269· φαγητό έξω περίπου £147· μηνιαία κάρτα συγκοινωνιών περίπου £33 και ένα εισιτήριο περίπου £2· κοινόχρηστα περίπου £177 συν ίντερνετ περίπου £22. Χωρίς ενοίκιο, περίπου £774. Μένουν σε λίρες, όπως τις τυπώνει η Wise.

source.en: Wise, cost of living in Turin

value.en: The Turin chamber of commerce, presenting its 2025 household survey on 6 May 2026, put average monthly spending of resident families at €2,616, almost unchanged from 2024. That figure is a household, not a student room.
value.el: Το εμπορικό επιμελητήριο του Τορίνο, παρουσιάζοντας την έρευνα νοικοκυριών του 2025 στις 6 Μαΐου 2026, έβαλε τη μέση μηνιαία δαπάνη των οικογενειών που μένουν στην πόλη στα €2.616, σχεδόν αμετάβλητη από το 2024. Το νούμερο είναι νοικοκυριό, όχι φοιτητικό δωμάτιο.

value.en: In July 2026 the City statistics office put the consumer-price index at 103.2, with 2025 as 100. The same release, as reported by ANSA, was +0.4% on June and +2.9% on July 2025. Housing and energy did much of that. The ranges above move with it.
value.el: Τον Ιούλιο 2026 η στατιστική υπηρεσία του Δήμου έβαλε τον δείκτη τιμών καταναλωτή στο 103,2, με βάση το 2025 = 100. Η ίδια ανακοίνωση, όπως τη μετέφερε το ANSA, ήταν +0,4% σε σχέση με τον Ιούνιο και +2,9% σε σχέση με τον Ιούλιο 2025. Σπίτι και ενέργεια έκαναν μεγάλο μέρος της ανόδου. Τα εύρη πιο πάνω κινούνται μαζί της.

source.en: Città di Torino, statistics office, July 2026

value.en: HousingAnywhere’s Turin page states an average rent around €940, usually €800–€1,100, on its own marketplace. Erasmus Play is a second student-housing search. Listings on either site are adverts and they change, so none is copied here. Safety of the area still comes before closeness or price.
value.el: Η σελίδα της HousingAnywhere για το Τορίνο γράφει μέσο ενοίκιο γύρω στα €940, συνήθως €800–€1.100, στη δική της αγορά. Το Erasmus Play είναι δεύτερη αναζήτηση φοιτητικής στέγης. Οι αγγελίες και στα δύο είναι διαφημίσεις και αλλάζουν, γι’ αυτό καμία δεν αντιγράφεται εδώ. Η ασφάλεια της περιοχής έρχεται πριν από την απόσταση ή την τιμή.
